title: ATrimsSMP
description: TrimsSMP but instead of attaching trims to swords, you gain special abilities for full armour trim sets.
body:
TrimsSMP but instead of attaching trims to swords, you gain special abilities for full armour trim sets.

# How To Use

1. Wear a full matching trim set
2. Hold Shift for 3 seconds
3. You will see Ability Ready in chat
4. Click Space
# Trims

## Silence Trim
Large sonic boom that deals 5 hearts damage, disables shields, knocks enemies back.
**Cooldown:** 90s
## Vex Trim
Gives Speed III.
**Cooldown:** 75s
## Bolt Trim
Summons a shockwave, flinging players into the air!
**Cooldown:** 80s
## Ward Trim
Creates a 10x10 dark field that gives blindness and wither effectfor 10 seconds.
**Cooldown:** 100s
## Flow Trim
Fast dash attack that damages enemies hit and keeps momentum.
**Cooldown:** 25s
